summary.value: Cilantro UWS is a casual Mexican and Southwestern restaurant at 485 Columbus Ave, around the corner from the American Museum of Natural History, with a tequila-heavy bar and weekend brunch. Restaurantji diners rate it 4.1 425 ratings and call it a Great brunch spot right by the museum of natural history. It suits a post-museum lunch with outdoor seating.

description.value: Cilantro UWS is a casual Mexican restaurant at 485 Columbus Ave on the Upper West Side. OpenTable describes authentic Mexican and Southwestern American cuisine in a casual, upbeat atmosphere, with a full bar of specialty cocktails and many varieties of tequila. The menu runs from guacamole and nachos to fajitas, tacos, burritos and enchiladas, with vegetarian and gluten-sensitive options. Brunch is served Friday through Sunday from 11am to 4pm, and OpenTable diners rate Cilantro UWS 4.1 from 23 reviews. Restaurantji diners recommend it for margaritas and mention very pleasant outdoor sitting.
